Name: Jemima
Summary: Jemima was Job's eldest daughter after his restoration, named in Job 42 among the three daughters born when God restored Job's fortunes twofold.
KeyStory: After Job's suffering, God gave him seven more sons and three daughters; Jemima, Kezia, and Keren-happuch were said to be the fairest women in all the land, and Job gave them an inheritance among their brothers.
LifeLesson: Jemima's story is part of Job's restoration — God does not merely replace what was lost, He honours what follows suffering.
